description: Use this when the user wants to change a formula's concentration (for example from an eau de parfum to an eau de toilette) or its finished weight: the app's Scale sheet. The concentrate scales and the finishing alcohol makes up the rest, added from the catalog's perfumer's ethanol when there is none. Capped at the concentrate's own strength. In place.

formula.description: The formula: its id (from list_formulas) or its exact name.

title: Scale to a concentration
